parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description: Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. If this parameter is set to true, the system only checks the access link required for creating the query history record without actually creating it. If this parameter is set to false or is not specified, the query history record is created. Default value: false.

parameters.name: QuerySql
parameters.description:
The query conditional statement.

You can edit the query statement based on the [SQL syntax for advanced event queries](~~2557373~~).

parameters.name: SimpleQuery
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the simple query mode.
